direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px/52px/1fr/56px, cols 184px/1fr/360px at 1366x768; FactoryStage >=55vw and >=60vh, Inspector internal-scroll only, DecisionBar pinned, no page scroll

direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room button; StepRail from single steps array, 9 steps plus completion, 36-40px aria-current buttons, remove dead Workspaces disclosures; GuideStrip 52px without duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px separating pre-flight nonce/identity route health from investigation evidence task; consent opens on selecting a recovery option; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre, one primary right; skip-to-stage first, then header>rail>guide>SVG nodes>inspector>DecisionBar, arrows in rail/SVG, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite for results only

Make FactoryStage fill available stage height and enlarge machine/route labels to >=11px so 120 vs 80 and JOB-1001/1002 read without inspector scroll at 1366x768.
Link ev-cert-qty/ev-recv-qty inspector rows bidirectionally to the Certificate/Receiving tracks with focus, hover and aria-current highlight.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT (nonce/identity, offline/no network request) visually and in tab order from the distinct Investigate evidence task and its Run Sample investigation primary.
Add explicit keyboard focus ring and aria-describedby to the route select stating Sample makes no live call and no model has run yet.
Reduce empty inspector panel height; align its bottom with stage legend to remove dead space.
Eliminate inspector vertical overflow: compress three option cards to 56px rows so typed APPROVE form and character count are fully visible at 768px without scrolling.
Keep consent form opening on option selection, but show exact phrase, expiry and disabled Accept state adjacent to the input; enable Accept only on exact match.
Mirror selected path on SVG with neon accepted-pending route and text marker, not colour alone.
Keep t1-t3 explicitly PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL and show 3 proposed / 0 tracked in DecisionBar centre status.
Draw MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts route only through feasible online cells and label 40+30 split on JOB-1001/JOB-1002 edges.
Give Decline proposal a secondary-button style and keyboard focus equal in clarity to Approve Britt's proposal.
Preserve red exception only on previewed CELL-MILL-2: red outline, STOPPED cross-hatch and PREVIEW - not applied text; keep all other preview elements silver/neon.
State in DecisionBar centre before applying: INVALIDATING ACTION - prior acceptance will be invalidated, and require the Apply second shock primary to be the sole primary.
Move Start a fresh scenario (admin) into a muted overflow menu so it does not compete with the shock workflow.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE in red with cross-hatch and remove any route through it; show 3 -> 2 feasible paths as a persistent stage banner tied to real state.
As in step 2, keep pre-flight nonce/identity route health separate from the Reinvestigate recovery evidence task and primary.
Mark Split available capacity CONSTRAINED on both SVG card and inspector with pattern plus text, not strikethrough colour alone.

Add diagonal pattern plus x CONSTRAINED text and reason Split requires at least two online compatible cells directly on the disabled option, keyboard-focusable for explanation.
Keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED - fresh review required in DecisionBar centre until exact typed phrase matches, then enable the single primary.
Keep coexistence explicit: collapsed Prior tracked work - 3 BLOCKED above, replacement t1-t3 PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL below, approved revised plan in DecisionBar status.
Ensure revised SVG route uses only CELL-MILL-1 while CELL-MILL-2 stays red offline/stopped; never route through it.
Make the Prior tracked work disclosure a real button with aria-expanded and arrow-key reachable blocked-task detail.

Remove duplicate primary ambiguity: DecisionBar shows Verify ledger while inspector also contains Verify ledger, Export and passphrase controls; keep one primary per state and demote inspector actions to secondary until their step state.
Compress Before-After and Evidence panels so passphrase field, Seal, Verify and Export statuses fit 768px without inspector scrollbar.
Add passphrase strength/requirements as live text tied to input, with aria-live polite only on validation result.
Retitle completion state consistently as Recovery story complete in rail with check plus text, and keep PACKET SEALED - 18 events - revised plan accepted centred in DecisionBar.
Show sealed/verified/exported as three separate Complete - current ledger check rows with icons and text, not colour alone, all visible without scroll.
Make Review recovery proof open a read-only proof summary focused on the sealed packet, with Esc returning focus to that button.
